summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of multi-payment methods in debt repayment modal. All features working correctly: payment method dropdown excludes 'Dette', conditional fields display properly for each payment type, OTP flow for Mobile Money works with demo code 123456, cash payment without OTP works.

issues: Minor: Console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - accessibility improvement needed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-payment feature in debt repayment modal fully tested. Key points: 1) Payment method dropdown correctly excludes 'Dette' option. 2) Each payment method shows appropriate conditional fields. 3) Mobile Money (Orange/MTN) requires OTP verification - demo code is 123456. 4) OTP phone numbers must be configured in Settings > Paiements Mobile Money (OTP) section. 5) Cash, Card, and Check payments work without OTP. 6) All data-testid attributes are properly set for testing.
